# ParCool for Fabric 26.3 - port build 1
First release of the unofficial Fabric port of **ParCool! 3.4.3.3** (by alRex_U) for **Minecraft 26.3**.

**Requires:** Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API (26.3), Architectury API 22.0.0+ (26.3), Java 25.
Optional: Mod Menu for a Configure button.

**Install:** put `parcool-...-fabric.jar` into your `mods` folder together with Fabric API and Architectury API. Disable other crawl mods. Back up your world first.

**Tested in game on 26.3:** ledge grab and pull up, horizontal and vertical wall run, wall jump, wall slide, crawl, slide, fast run, vault, dodge, roll/breakfall, cat leap, flips, hide in block, dive, sky dive, fast swim, quick turn, fence climbing, hanging from bars, zipline, energy drink brewing, settings screen, stamina HUD, third-person animations.

**Changes compared to the original:**
- Fabric (through Architectury API) instead of NeoForge; ported to Minecraft 26.3.
- Fixed: key binding category shown untranslated in Controls.
- Added: Mod Menu support.

**Not included:** ParCool 4.0 features (grappling hook, skill tree, equipment).

This is an unofficial port. Report problems in this repository's Issues, not to the original author.
